hero.tagline: Compare only the weather you need, at a glance
hero.subtitle: A simple weather app to intuitively check today's weather with recent feels-like temperature changes, and quickly compare weather across multiple regions.

weather.title: 8-Day Feels-Like Temperature
weather.desc: Intuitively check changes in feels-like temperature over the last 8 days including today.

comparison.title: Multi-Region Comparison
comparison.desc: Quickly compare the weather of multiple regions on a single screen.

widget.title: Home Screen Widget
widget.desc: Easily check essential weather info directly from your home screen without opening the app.

multilang.title: Multi-Language Support
multilang.desc: Supports Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, German, French, and Italian.

offline.title: Offline Cache
offline.desc: Stores recently fetched data so you can check the weather even with unstable networks.

nogps.title: No GPS Required
nogps.desc: Does not require background location access, saving your battery and privacy.

refresh.title: Weather Refresh Methods
refresh.row2_method: Pull down to refresh group data

structure.row5_desc: Same region cannot be in same group twice
structure.row6_desc: Cannot change to a region already in single list
